listing.name: OpenGTPS1 (Gran Turismo 2)
listing.summary: Explore OpenGTPS1 (Gran Turismo 2) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Keep an existing permitted prepared copy
steps.instruction: Upstream has not granted a license for its original OpenGTPS1 code; this guide does not establish permission to build, acquire or register another copy. If you already have a permitted prepared Windows x64 copy, its GranTurismo2PC.exe uses your own exact US GT2 Simulation revision 2 (SCUS-94488) and Arcade (SCUS-94455) raw Mode 2/2352 images, checked by upstream’s native setup. Choose that prepared game executable and its writable folder, and launch separately. Optional GT1 content merging is excluded from this handoff pending its separate acceptance; do not infer that it is qualified here.

steps.title: Keep updates and data with your working copy
steps.instruction: Keep your original files and a separate working installation. You or upstream own runtime replacement, generated data, saves and settings; prepare updates in a separate folder and retain the current copy until ready. Portcove’s existing-installation review saves your selected launch details without running a helper. It does not back up, roll back or delete this external runtime.
